draftedFindings.title: Clamp n to the slice length in first
draftedFindings.body: `first(&[1, 2], 3)` and `first(&[], 1)` panic because the slice endpoint exceeds the length. The existing `last` helper handles oversized requests by returning all available items. Use `&items[..n.min(items.len())]` to give `first` the same behavior.
